title: 10 Best Cat Cafés in Myeongdong 2026
description: The best cat cafés in Myeongdong, Seoul — curated from Reddit reviews. Ethical, clean, and cat-friendly spots with interactive map included.

places.name: Cat Playground (고양이놀이터)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:Around 50 cats of various breeds — Norwegian Forest, Persian, American Shorthair, and even a Sphinx. Admission includes unlimited time, one free drink, and a churu cat treat. Located on the 3rd floor near Myeongdong Station Exit 6.

redditQuotes.text: Kids would be so happy to go to a cat or dog cafe! I'll check out goyangi playground!
Cure, restful, lovely staff. Reasonable price. Just a lovely roomy Cat Cafe and all the Cats are so content.

places.insiderTip: The gold standard Myeongdong cat café. 50 cats, impeccably clean, and the staff genuinely cares. The heated floor seating area is perfect for winter visits. The Creatrip discount (₩12,000 vs ₩15,000) is worth knowing about.

places.name: Cat's Sarangchae (캣츠사랑채)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:Over 55 cats in a spacious, cozy 3rd-floor space that feels like stepping into a calm, fluffy world. Known for its ethical treatment of cats and welcoming atmosphere. Hugely popular on TikTok and Instagram.

redditQuotes.text: This ethical Cat Cafe with over 55 cats is my new favorite one — it's located in Myeongdong and all of the cats here are so friendly and so cute.
Welcome to Cat's Sarangchae, a cozy 3rd-floor cat café that feels like stepping into a calm, fluffy little world away from the chaos downstairs.

places.insiderTip: The TikTok-famous one, and it earns the hype. 55+ cats in a genuinely cozy space with owners who clearly prioritize animal welfare. The cats are sociable and well-adjusted — not stressed or hiding. Slightly pricier, but you're paying for quality.

places.name: Roofcatme Myeongdong (루프캣미)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:Unlimited drinks included with admission — no pressure to leave quickly. Spacious, impeccably clean environment with plenty of toys for the cats. WiFi available for remote work. Regular feeding times let you see the cats' personalities shine.

redditQuotes.text: I finally went to my first Cat Cafe in Korea and it was such a fun time with my family. No appointment necessary, 20,000 Won.

places.insiderTip: The unlimited drinks policy is a game-changer — it removes any guilt about lingering, and you will want to linger. Perfect as a mid-shopping break in Myeongdong. The cats are well-socialized and genuinely enjoy human interaction.

places.name: Cat Cafe Attic Cat (고양이다락방)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:Probably the most well-known cat café in Myeongdong. Colorful yet cozy nooks, decent lattes, and friendly cats who are used to visitors. The owner and her husband are welcoming and show you tricks to interact with the cats. Also has a Gangnam location.

redditQuotes.text: Out of all the cat cafes in Myeongdong, this one is probably the most popular. And for good reason — it does cafe as well as it does cat. Colorful yet cozy nooks and decent lattes.

places.insiderTip: The OG Myeongdong cat café that still delivers. It strikes the perfect balance — genuinely good coffee, cozy atmosphere, and social cats. The owners clearly love what they do. A reliable choice when you want both café quality and cat cuddles.

places.name: Cafe Gaene Myeongdong (카페개네)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:A well-reviewed animal café featuring both cats and dogs. Highly recommended on Facebook's Korea Travel Guide group. Spacious enough for families with children. Great food alongside the animal interaction.

redditQuotes.text: Highly recommend Cat Cafe in Myeongdong. A must visit cafe in Myeongdong!! Awesome food and very cute.

places.insiderTip: The hybrid option — if someone in your group prefers dogs over cats, Cafe Gaene has both. The food is a genuine draw here too, not just an afterthought. Good for families who want animal interaction without committing to cats-only.

places.name: Myeongdong Cat Café (4th Floor Hideaway)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:Tucked away on the 4th floor, this cozy sanctuary feels like a secret escape from the shopping chaos below. Entrance fee includes a complimentary drink. Heaters and heated blankets in winter make it extra cozy. Smaller, more intimate atmosphere.

redditQuotes.text: Tucked away on the 4th floor, this cozy cat sanctuary offers a genuine escape from the urban chaos below. Heaters and heated blankets for ultimate comfort during cooler months.

places.insiderTip: The introvert's pick. Smaller, quieter, and genuinely hidden — you won't find tour groups here. The heated blankets in winter are a brilliant touch. Plan to stay 30 minutes, end up staying two hours.

places.name: Cat Beer Cafe
places.whatToOrder: What to know:The only cat café in Seoul where you can pair craft beers with cat cuddles. Extensive Belgian brew selection. Manga available for browsing. Evening-focused vibe — perfect for unwinding after a day of shopping. Cats roam freely between the tables.

redditQuotes.text: This quirky spot stands out by combining craft beers with cat companionship — a truly unique twist on the traditional cat cafe concept. The laid-back evening vibe here is unmatched.

places.insiderTip: Cats + Belgian craft beer + manga = genius. This is not in Myeongdong proper (it's in Seodaemun-gu), but worth the short trip for an evening session. Perfect for anyone who thinks cat cafés are just for kids.

places.name: Cat Cafe Library
places.whatToOrder: What to know:A Hongdae cat café that doubles as a reading nook, stocked with comics and Korean novels. Frozen lattes are a standout menu item. Private cubicles available if you want to read or work quietly. Less about active play, more about peaceful coexistence.

redditQuotes.text: The combination of books and cats creates a calming atmosphere that encourages you to stay for hours. It's less about active play and more about peaceful coexistence with your temporary feline roommates.

places.insiderTip: The literary cat café for people who want to curl up with a book while cats nap nearby. Not in Myeongdong (it's in Hongdae, ~20 min by subway), but worth combining with a Hongdae visit. The frozen lattes are genuinely great.

places.name: Y Cat (와이캣)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:37 cats including Somali, Maine Coon, Russian Blue, Exotic, and American Shorthair. ₩9,000 entrance fee includes a latte. Shoes off, slippers on. Spacious interior with cardboard cat beds occupied by snoozing kitties. Located near Hapjeong station (Line 2 & 6).

redditQuotes.text: Incredibly spacious and well appointed for both humans and cats. I particularly enjoyed seeing all the cardboard cat beds which were occupied by snoozing kitties, including two sweet gray babies posing as yin and yang.

places.insiderTip: Best value on this list — ₩9,000 with a latte included is a steal. 37 cats in a genuinely spacious room means no overcrowding. Not in Myeongdong (Hapjeong, ~25 min by subway), but the variety of cat breeds here is impressive.

places.name: Cat Garden (캣가든)
places.whatToOrder: What to know:An extremely unique concept — a huge outdoor backyard filled with tons of free-roaming cats. You can borrow mats to sit outdoors. Unlike any indoor cat café. Located near Gimpo Airport in Gangseo-gu.

redditQuotes.text: Cat garden was my favourite cat cafe — it's an extremely huge backyard with tons of cats. You can borrow some mats to sit down outdoors as well.
Cat garden near Gimpo airport was really really fun.

places.insiderTip: The furthest from Myeongdong (~40 min by subway to Gimpo), but Reddit's #1 cat café in Seoul. The outdoor concept is completely different from every other cat café — open air, sprawling garden, cats everywhere. If you have the time, make the trip. Combine with Gimpo Sky Mall nearby.
